title: Torus Knot T(3, 5)
formula: r(φ) = ((R + r cos(5φ)) cos(3φ), (R + r cos(5φ)) sin(3φ), -r sin(5φ))
parametric_fn: (u, v, target) => { const p = 3, q = 5, R = 2.2, r = 0.85, rTube = 0.32; const phi = u, theta = v; const cr = R + r * Math.cos(q * phi); const cx = cr * Math.cos(p * phi); const cy = cr * Math.sin(p * phi); const cz = -r * Math.sin(q * phi); const nx = Math.cos(theta) * Math.cos(p * phi); const ny = Math.cos(theta) * Math.sin(p * phi); const nz = Math.sin(theta); target.set(cx + rTube * nx, cy + rTube * ny, cz + rTube * nz).multiplyScalar(0.48); }
